[[File:ExplorCorpsScoutship-TJP.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An ExplorCorps scout ship]]
An '''ExplorCorps scout ship''' was a large model of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exploration Corps/Legends|Exploration Corps]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the [[New Sith Wars]]. They were used to meet with [[Species/Legends|species]] wishing to join the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

ExplorCorps ships were lightly armed, because they were mainly used for sensors and consumables. They were used extensively by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and a few of them were stationed on every [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]].
